steps: Open one database transaction for the entire load plan.
Verify skipped.rejected and skipped.manualReview are acknowledged by the operator before writes.
Write rows table by table in dependency order.
Rollback the entire transaction on the first write, validation, or constraint failure.
Commit only after all table writes and post-write counts match the load plan summary.

tables.notes: County code is the preserved municipality/county-equivalent identifier.
County plus numeric NAICS identifies one CBP row under the current filtered import policy.
Title plus address is the dry-run boundary key until a better source identifier is available.

writeGuards: Never truncate production tables from this loader.
Never change table schema from this loader.
Require explicit operator approval for non-empty skipped records.
